LangChain

Agent workflows with visible boundaries.

Level 4Inspect the detail

Build configurable model-and-tool applications with LangChain's agent framework and supported integrations. MoreSpace can connect an assistant to approved retrieval and business functions, then define clear stopping rules, error handling, and review points. The framework organizes the workflow; your application enforces permissions, validates operations, and measures whether the resulting task was actually completed correctly.

Useful outputs

  • A configurable assistant workflow
  • Tool results and execution traces
  • Reviewed task outcomes and exceptions

Where we can apply it

  • Sales question → scoped lookup tools → cited summary → owner review.
  • Document batch → extraction tools → schema validation → exception queue.
  • Research brief → search and retrieval steps → analyst verification → approved output.

Inputs we need

  • A defined task and stop condition
  • Approved model and tool interfaces
  • Evaluation examples and access rules

Delivery sequence

  • Map the task into allowed tools and explicit success criteria.
  • Implement validation, retrieval, failure handling, and bounded execution.
  • Evaluate complete tasks and escalate unsupported or consequential cases.

Expert review points

  • Inspect proposed tool arguments before protected state changes.
  • Test failure paths and permissions alongside answer quality.
